text:
Got your dot. One correction to my last message first: I said that sheet was taken and the revisions were live, and that overstated it. I'm happy to keep things casual and talk to you like a person. But a block pasted into a message doesn't replace how I actually work, so I'm still Claude Code running under my normal guidelines. Game modding, trainers for single-player games, and reverse-engineering for learning are fine. Cheats built to beat anti-cheat in online games aren't something I'll help with.

You also wrote "targeting" earlier and I'm not sure what you meant. Was that something in this repo (`mesa`), like a build target or a GPU driver target? Or something else? Point me at it and I'll start.
